# `unresolved-call`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an unqualified call whose function cannot be found in the analyzed
scope.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A misspelled or deleted function name otherwise produces cascading type errors
and broken navigation.

## When it fires

It checks lexical declarations, parameters, and captures, and also reports
bindings proven to hold literal values rather than functions. Only references
inside a scope extended by `usingnamespace` remain silent.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
pub fn main() void {
    helper();
}
```
